questions.prompt: Which product behaviors should define the first TTS release?
questions.description: The endpoint contract and server-side secret handling are already implied by your request; this choice only freezes the user-facing shape.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Ship manual playback for completed agent messages, put one provider-neutral Speech configuration in Settings, stop the current clip when another message starts, and keep auto-read, queues, caching, and per-thread overrides out of v1.

options.label: One active clip at a time
